# Use each spaces naming namespace in its accepted role

In this UI family, script-addressed containers use names such as spacesToolbarAddonsContainer, shared CSS classes are dashed spaces-toolbar-button/spaces-badge-container, the related menuitem appends -menuitem, and styles use --spaces-button-badge-bg-color. Public schema types use UpperCamelCase and fields lowerCamelCase. Follow this mapping for nearby additions rather than applying one case style to every namespace. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Extension spaces DOM CSS and API naming.
